## Purpose and entry points
TextGen is a local-first desktop/web runtime for loading and serving LLMs, with chat, free-form generation, multimodal inputs, tools, LoRA training, image generation, and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs. The principal Python process starts at `server.py`; OS launchers bootstrap it via `start_linux.sh`, `start_windows.bat`, and `start_macos.sh`. Portable releases can embed it in Electron through `desktop/main.js`.

## Runtime composition and state
Global runtime settings, CLI flags, shared model handles, and user-data locations are centralized in `modules/shared.py` and `modules/paths.py`. Persistent, user-owned assets are segregated under `user_data/`: models and LoRAs, character and instruction-template YAML, presets, grammars, tools, training data, and per-user settings. This separates mutable local content from application code and permits a custom data root via CLI.

## Model discovery, selection, and backend loading
The model lifecycle is coordinated by `modules/models.py`, with backend detection/configuration in `modules/models_settings.py` and loader dispatch in `modules/loaders.py`. Backend-specific adapters include `modules/llama_cpp_server.py` (including an external llama-server boundary), `modules/transformers_loader.py`, `modules/exllamav3.py`, and `modules/tensorrt_llm.py`. Models are selected from `user_data/models`, optionally combined with LoRAs from `user_data/loras`; switching is intended to work without restarting the server.

## Generation and prompt pipeline
UI/API requests converge on prompt construction and generation: instruction templates and prompt rules in `modules/prompts.py`, conversation rendering/state in `modules/chat.py`, and token-stream generation/sampling in `modules/text_generation.py`. Logit transforms, samplers, grammar constraints, reasoning controls, and tool-call parsing form a post-model control boundary in `modules/logits.py`, `modules/grammar/logits_process.py`, and `modules/tool_parsing.py`. The pipeline formats chat history and attachments into backend inputs, streams generated tokens, then parses/renderers model output for the requester.

## Interfaces: Gradio UI, local API, desktop shell
The browser UI is assembled through `modules/ui.py`, with distinct chat and notebook surfaces in `modules/ui_chat.py` and `modules/ui_notebook.py`; static behavior and presentation reside in `js/` and `css/`. The HTTP API is a separate adapter layer rooted at `modules/api/script.py`, exposing OpenAI-style completion/chat and Anthropic-style messages handlers such as `modules/api/completions.py` and `modules/api/anthropic.py`. Electron launches/preloads the local service rather than replacing the Python application: `desktop/main.js`, `desktop/preload.js`.

## Extensibility, tools, and multimodal features
Extensions are dynamically managed by `modules/extensions.py`, loading built-in modules from `extensions/` and user-installed ones from `user_data/extensions`. Tool execution is handled by `modules/tool_use.py` against one-file tools in `user_data/tools`, with optional web-search integration through `modules/web_search.py`. Image attachment/model support is separated into `modules/image_utils.py` and `modules/image_models.py`; image generation has its own UI path in `modules/ui_image_generation.py`.

## Training and deployment targets
LoRA fine-tuning is implemented in `modules/training.py` and `modules/LoRA.py`, consuming datasets under `user_data/training/datasets`. The main runtime is Python 3.9+ with hardware-specific dependency profiles under `requirements/portable/` and `requirements/full/`, spanning CPU, CUDA/NVIDIA, ROCm/AMD, Vulkan, and Apple variants. Containerized deployments are provided per accelerator in `docker/nvidia/docker-compose.yml`, `docker/amd/docker-compose.yml`, and `docker/cpu/docker-compose.yml`; release workflows build portable variants under `.github/workflows/`.
